rics.meaning: PPP for GDP — purchasing power parity conversion factor. Number of IDR with the same purchasing power as 1 USD in the US economy.
rics.how_to_use: Currently ~Rp 4,500 per USD (vs market exchange rate ~Rp 16,000/USD). Large gap reflects Indonesia's lower price level — a $1 in Indonesia buys ~3.5x what $1 buys in the US for typical goods.
